title: Poster
description: An asymmetric poster page: a large title and its lead, then the page. Stacked, it keeps the left of the slide so the shapes of the backdrop compose the right; split, the title takes the left and the page the right.
instructions: Use for openings, objectives, part openers and recaps. Keep the title to two lines and the lead to one or two sentences. stack: the text keeps the left 60 % of the slide (the backdrop's tableau takes the rest); split: title on the left, page on the right.

arrangement.title: Arrangement
arrangement.description: stack: title, lead and page one under the other, on the left of the slide; split: title and lead on the left, the page on the right.
